The '''uniforms''' worn by the [[Chiss family/Legends|family]] personnel of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]'s [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]] consisted of<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> a tight-fitting tunic and high-topped black collars.<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> The family was denoted by uniform [[Color/Legends|color]]: [[Mitth family/Legends|Mitth family]] was burgundy<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> and [[Chaf family/Legends|Chaf family]] was yellow.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

A burgundy variant worn by the [[Chiss warrior/Legends|Chiss warriors]] of [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx]] had an [[Empire of the Hand|Imperial]] [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|rank insignia plaque]].<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> A variant was worn by the [[Phalanx (Chiss)|Household Phalanx]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]], which included a burgundy uniform worn by Commander [[Kres'ten'tarthi]] of [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]]'s Household Phalanx.<ref name="Red Sky, Blue Flame">{{GamerCite|7|Red Sky, Blue Flame}}</ref>

The crew of<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> the [[Chaf family/Legends|Fifth Ruling Family]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|117|Chaf Exalted}}</ref> ''[[Chaf Exalted]]''&mdash;a [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] under the [[Chaf'orm'bintrano's fleet|fleet]] of [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]]&mdash;wore yellow uniforms.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Although [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Hess'irolia'nuruodo]] was described wearing a burgundy-and-black uniform in the novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]'',<ref name="Force Heretic II">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref> a color scheme previously only seen among the [[Chiss warrior/Legends|Chiss warriors]] from [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx]],<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> her depiction in the ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' has her wear a [[Defense Fleet uniform]] with [[Red Flame (symbol)|red piping]] along her arms that represented the [[Red Flame]] ideal.<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
